image_description: Two individuals standing outdoors in academic regalia. The person on the left wears a gold-colored gown and a mortarboard cap with a tassel. The person on the right wears a black doctoral-style gown with velvet panels on the front and sleeves, over a white shirt and tie. Both are smiling at the camera against a blurred background of trees.

Both gowns exhibit clear bilateral symmetry and a central vertical opening consistent with academic robes.
The fabric hangs loosely, effectively hiding the underlying body shape, particularly around the torso and arms.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The subject on the right clearly displays the characteristic wide, bell-shaped doctoral sleeves that extend past the hands.
Distinct vertical panels (velvet on the black gown) are visible along the front opening.
A white collared shirt and tie are clearly visible underneath the black gown.

No specular highlights or shiny textures are observed on the gown surfaces.
